correctness.rationale: Over GF(2), nonzero quartic equations are precisely 32767 normalized masks on 15 monomials. Independently re-enumerated GL3(F2) orbits to 279, and checked the 279 representative Jacobian ideals on all three affine charts by exact Gröbner bases: 78 smooth orbits of total weight 10920. For geometric even-contact lines, a restricted binary quartic is a square over the closure iff its odd monomial coefficients c3,c1 vanish. Independently scanned every rational line over explicit GF(2^k), k=1..7, for the 78 smooth representatives, inverted the fixed-point sums N_k=Σ_{d|k}d m_d and recovered all ten weighted/orbit partition bins including (7):3072 equations and 20 classes. Completeness beyond finite-extension bound follows from the classical at-most-seven geometric bitangents of a smooth plane quartic in characteristic two; not an extrapolation of field-degree experiments. Independently checked the GF128 witness conjugates (9,11) through its complete Frobenius orbit. Limits: F2 plane quartic equations only; no broader field claim.
